name: meant-profile
description: Meant profiles, the meaning layer for Internet Computer canister calls: the Candid Profile v0 spec, its schema and standard packs, and the @meantjs packages that read them.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate.mjs && node scripts/validate.mjs examples/tokens.profile.json --did examples/tokens.did
scripts.fixtures: node scripts/validate.mjs packs/icrc1.profile.json --resolved > fixtures/icrc1.resolved.json && node scripts/validate.mjs packs/icrc2.profile.json --resolved > fixtures/icrc2.resolved.json && node scripts/validate.mjs examples/tokens.profile.json --did examples/tokens.did --resolved > fixtures/tokens-example.resolved.json && node scripts/validate.mjs packs/erc20.profile.json --resolved > fixtures/erc20.resolved.json && npm run data -w packages/resolver
